Nina (Finance): Quick kickoff: running a dry-run for the "legacy rate shield" experiment. Objective: confirm invoice previews and proration behavior before any visible changes. Need owners for metering, CSV validation, comms, and rollback criteria.

Jamal (Billing): I can do CSV validation. Will need a sample export with cohort tag and invoice_preview rows. Prefer a column `legacy_shield=true|false`.

Priya (RevOps): I'll handle customer-facing language. Proposal: email + in-app banner to affected accounts 72h before any actual rate change. For dry-run we should still surface previews so customers can see it in their billing UI. :memo:

Evgeny (Product): Technical ask: include `pricing_metadata:{shield_version, effective_date, opted_in}` in /account API so Console and SDKs can render correct messaging. Keep the JSON minimal — `shield_v1` is fine.

Marta (Billing Ops): Metering notes: we'll tag accounts with acct.metadata.pricing_tag=legacy_shield_v1. Metering pipeline will emit `legacy_shield:true` on staged token aggregates. I'll add an env var so we can toggle without deploy.

Nina (Finance): Runbook sketch:
```
- Tag cohorts in staging + smoke test (test-tenant-2)
- Emit `legacy_shield` flag in staged metering; run aggregation for 14 days
- Generate invoice_preview CSV, compare against baseline (diff script)
- Validate proration: ensure annual upgrades don't change until renewal unless opt-in
- Canary plan: 0.5% of legacy-monthly for 48 hours, monitor invoice_preview_count, refunds_count, and token_delta_pct
- Gating: block rollout if refunds_count > 3 or token_delta_pct > 7%
- Rollback: remove tag + re-run previews, trigger automated support notices if affected invoices already created
```

Jamal (Billing): I'll produce a sample CSV by EOD with columns: account_id, billing_cycle_start, billing_cycle_end, plan, applied_rate, legacy_shield, invoice_preview_amount, tokens_billed. Will run `csvdiff` against baseline.

Priya (RevOps): For the comms: short subject line "Your billing preview: unchanged unless you opt-in". Include FAQ: how to opt in, how proration is handled, where to see preview CSV. I'll post drafts in the ticket.

BillingBot: Ticket FIN-4032 created by Nina (Finance): "legacy rate shield - dry run and canary". https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4032

Evgeny (Product): One more: add a tiny eval that simulates system-message-heavy conversations. Some customers prepend instructions which inflate token counts; we need to catch any systematic shifts.

Marta (Billing Ops): Will add a reconciliation job: compare staged token aggregates to production baseline per-account; flag accounts with >7% change and send to `billing-team-alerts` channel.

Nina (Finance): Meeting to approve canary window tomorrow 10:00. Action items: Jamal => sample CSV, Marta => flag emission in staging, Priya => drafts, Evgeny => API field PR. We'll only flip live after dry-run results are green. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
